RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 20

An all-female panel is not evidence of discrimination. Panels are usually assembled based on role seniority, departmental structure, or availability. Modern public broadcasters frequently prioritize specific strategic competencies—such as digital media expertise—over raw tenure or traditional newsroom experience. In addition, final shortlist selections depend heavily on interview performance and future editorial vision.

Raising allegations of gender bias without concrete evidence is unsubstantiated and could severely harm your professional reputation and internal relationships. Instead, send a polite follow-up requesting constructive feedback on your interviews, specifically asking how you can develop your digital media capabilities to improve your candidacy for future leadership roles.
